intro: From mid to late April 2026, ZCyberNews covered five data-leak incidents, with the threat actor 0APT appearing as the most frequently observed. The leaks impacted a range of sectors including business services, e-commerce, education, financial-services, and freelance-services, with a global reach. The severity of these incidents was distributed as one medium, three high, and one critical, reflecting a significant concentration of serious breaches during this period.
